name: Cariprazine
metabolism: Metabolized mainly by CYP3A4 and less by CYP2D6 to active desmethylcariprazine (DCAR) and didesmethylcariprazine (DDCAR). DDCAR undergoes further CYP3A4 hydroxylation. Little parent drug is excreted unchanged in urine.
summary: Cariprazine is an oral atypical antipsychotic used to treat schizophrenia and bipolar disorder. It is also prescribed as an add-on treatment for bipolar depression and major depressive disorder.
